title: Trump’s envoys Witkoff and Kushner to fly to Pakistan for Iran talks
byline: Donald Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff and the US president’s son-in-law Jared Kushner are heading to Pakistan for peace talks with Iran on Saturday morning, the White House has said.

title: Showers expected in parts of the island after 2pm
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in the Galle, Matara, Kandy, Nuwara-Eliya and Puttalam districts after 2.00 pm, the Department of Meteorology said.

title: Iran’s foreign minister arrives in Pakistan, Trump expects offer satisfying US demands
byline: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi arrived in the Pakistani capital Islamabad on Friday to discuss proposals for restarting peace talks with the US, offering some hope for an end to the eight-week war that has killed thousands and sown turmoil in global markets.

title: Photographer arrested with over 2.5kg ‘Kush’ at BIA
byline: A Sri Lankan passenger has been arrested at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) for the possession of 2,505 grams of ‘Kush’ cannabis, estimated to be valued at approximately Rs. 25 million.

title: US Democrats look to rein in Trump’s war powers, this time on Cuba
byline: The US Senate will vote as soon as next week on a Democratic-led effort to prevent President Donald Trump from launching an attack on Cuba, Senate aides said on Friday, responding to the Republican’s threats to take military action against the island.

title: Expert raises concerns over Finance Ministry’s cybersecurity measures after BEC attack
byline: Cybersecurity expert Asela Waidyalankara states that technical measures are available to prevent incidents such as hackers gaining access to funds, as seen in the reported cyberattack involving a USD 2.5 million Treasury payment.

title: Father killed in dispute with son in Athirahapitiya
byline: Police have arrested a man on suspicion of murdering his father by attacking him with a sharp weapon.

title: ‘Ehipassiko - Walk for Peace’ enters fourth day
byline: The fourth day of the ‘Ehipassiko - Walk for Peace’ is scheduled to commence today (25) from the Beligammana Rajamaha Viharaya in Mawanella.

title: US boosts Iran war assets with third aircraft carrier USS George HW Bush
byline: A third US aircraft carrier has arrived in the Middle East, bringing thousands more American troops and dozens of advanced fighter jets to the region.

title: Russian-made firearm, ammunition found buried in Karandeniya Raju’s garden
byline: A 9mm Russian-made pistol and 15 rounds of ammunition were discovered buried in the garden of the residence of “Karandeniye Raju,” the brother of organised criminal “Karandeniye Sudda,” during a specialised search operation.

title: Suspect arrested at BIA with foreign cigarettes worth Rs. 38.67 mln
byline: A suspect has been arrested by Sri Lanka Customs officials at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) for attempting to smuggle a consignment of foreign-made cigarettes and electronic cigarettes valued at Rs. 38.67 million into the country.

title: Advisory issued for severe lightning
byline: An ‘Amber’ advisory has been issued by the Department of Meteorology for severe lightning in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, and North-Western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts.

title: Norway to assist Sri Lanka to strengthen fisheries monitoring with modern technology
byline: Sri Lanka has entered into a significant agreement with Norway aimed at enhancing the country’s fisheries monitoring capabilities through the integration of modern technology.

title: Turkish foreign minister says Israel has become ‘direct threat to global security,’ urges ‘collective response’
byline: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said Friday that Israel now poses “direct threat to global security” and urged a “collective” international response, arguing that growing instability can no longer be viewed through a purely regional lens.

title: Taylor Swift and Bad Bunny top Spotify’s first all-time most streamed artists list
byline: Taylor Swift has topped Spotify’s first ever list of the most streamed artists of all time, published Thursday morning.

title: Sri Lanka Police urge public discipline for “Walk for Peace” journey
byline: Sri Lanka Police have requested the public to maintain strict discipline and restraint to ensure the success of the internationally acclaimed “Ehipassiko – Walk for Peace.”

title: Associate of ‘Homagama Gagana’ arrested with 12kg of heroin
byline: A suspect was arrested in Homagama yesterday (24) by the Western Province North Crimes Division while in possession of 12 kilograms of heroin, with an estimated street value of approximately Rs. 120 million.

title: Sri Lanka’s tourist arrivals exceed 840,000 so far this year
byline: The Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA) stated that the number of tourist arrivals in Sri Lanka so far has crossed the 840,000 mark.

title: ‘Sagarika’ train successfully re-railed; full restoration work ongoing
byline: The ‘Sagarika’ train, which derailed near the Wadduwa Railway Station yesterday, has been successfully re-railed, said Ada Derana reporter.

title: 126 drunk drivers arrested during special police operation
byline: A total of 20 individuals directly linked to criminal activities have been identified and arrested under the ‘Nation United - National Drive’ campaign aimed at eradicating narcotics from the country, according to a report issued yesterday (24).

title: El Nino conditions likely to emerge by May-July 2026, says World Meteorological Organisation
byline: The latest monthly Global Seasonal Climate Update issued by the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) has indicated a clear shift in the Equatorial Pacific, with rapidly rising sea-surface temperatures pointing towards a likely return of El Nino conditions as early as May-July 2026.

title: Americans blame Trump for gas price surge, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
byline: A clear majority of Americans blame President Donald Trump for surging gasoline prices, which is weighing on his Republican Party ahead of November’s congressional midterm elections, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll.

title: Scam Alert: Public warned of new digital scam involving malicious APK files
byline: Sri Lanka Police have announced that it successfully identified information regarding a new digital scam targeting bank accounts.

title: Sri Lanka’s fuel import bill expected to rise sharply in 2026 – CBSL forecast
byline: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka has projected a significant increase in the country’s fuel import expenditure in 2026, citing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and continued volatility in global oil markets as key contributing factors.

title: US freezes US$344 million in Iran-linked crypto assets
byline: The United States has frozen US$344 million in cryptocurrency assets over ties to Iran, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Friday (Apr 24), as Washington seeks to raise pressure on Tehran amid energy supply disruptions due to war in the Middle East.

title: Tehran’s Imam Khomeini airport resumes some international flights
byline: Tehran’s Imam Khomeini International Airport resumed some international flights this morning.

title: Frequent lightning threat endangers lives of Pitakanda residents
byline: Residents of Pitakanda village in the Ayagama Divisional Secretariat Division of Ratnapura District are calling for the installation of lightning protection systems owing to the serious and ongoing threat due to frequent lightning strikes.

title: Significant progress made in probe into USD 2.5M cyber heist - Dy Minister
byline: Significant progress has been made in investigations into the incident in which a loan installment of USD 2.5 million owed by the government to a foreign entity was diverted to an external party, the Deputy Minister of Digital Economy, Eranga Weeraratne stated.

title: Govt. aiming to significantly reduce road accidents and deaths by 2029: Transport Minister
byline: More than 2,700 people die annually due to road accidents in Sri Lanka, the Ministry of Transport, Highways and Urban Development, Bimal Rathnayake has stated.

title: Pakistan ‘facilitating Iran-US talks’ - Foreign Ministry
byline: A social media update from Pakistan’s foreign ministry says Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar - who is also foreign minister - held a meeting today “to review the latest developments in the region”.

title: CEB records Rs. 38.7 billion loss in 2025 despite tariff revisions – CBSL
byline: The Ceylon Electricity Board (CEB) recorded a significant financial loss of Rs. 38.7 billion in 2025, despite multiple electricity tariff revisions during the year, according to the Central Bank’s Annual Economic Review 2025.

title: Four arrested in Pettah with stock of narcotics pills worth Rs. 20 million
byline: Four individuals have been arrested at four separate locations in Pettah in connection with the possession and distribution of a large stock of narcotics tablets valued at nearly Rs. 20 million.

title: CoPF to summon Finance Ministry officials over USD 2.5M payment issue – Harsha
byline: Steps will be taken to summon the Secretary to the Ministry of Finance and other relevant officials before the Committee on Public Finance (CoPF) as soon as possible over an incident involving a US$2.5 million foreign debt repayment, the Chairman of the committee Parliamentarian Dr. Harsha de Silva stated.

title: Sagarika train derails again at Kompannavidiya
byline: The Sagarika train, which derailed yesterday (24), has derailed once again while returning to Colombo after being restored to the tracks, the Department of Railways stated.

title: Sri Lankan among crew of oil tanker hijacked by pirates off the coast of Somalia
byline: Pirates have hijacked an oil tanker with 17 crew including a Sri Lankan that was sailing near the Somali coast, according to multiple security officials who spoke to the BBC.

title: Iran shares ‘views and considerations’ with Pakistan on ending war - Foreign Minister
byline: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has released a statement following his meeting with Pakistan’s head of armed forces, Asim Munir.

title: Asanga Seneviratne elected President of National Olympic Committee
byline: The President of the Sri Lanka Baseball Federation Asanga Seneviratne has been elected the new president of the National Olympic Committee (NOC).

title: Sajith calls for Parliamentary Select Committee to probe US$2.5M treasury payment
byline: The Leader of the Opposition, Sajith Premadasa has called for the appointment of a Parliamentary Select Committee to investigate the incident in which the Treasury allegedly transferred US$2.5 million to a third-party account.

title: Iran’s foreign minister meets Pakistani PM in Islamabad
byline: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif have begun talks in Islamabad, according to the Pakistani officials and Iranian state media, as Araghchi kicks off a diplomatic tour of the region.

title: ‘Ehipassiko - Walk for Peace’ nears Colombo as fourth day concludes
byline: The internationally recognized “Ehipassiko” peace walk, led by Venerable Pannakara Thero and a group of monks visiting from the United States, successfully concluded its fourth day this afternoon (25).

title: Digital motor insurance cards to be introduced from May
byline: Digital motor insurance cards are expected to be introduced from May 01, the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development has announced.

title: Iranian MP warns regional countries of ‘destruction of infrastructure’ if US attacks again
byline: Iranian MP Mahmoud Nabavian has threatened regional countries with destructive action if the United States attacks its territory again.

title: Police Media Spokesperson departs for INTERPOL conference in France
byline: The Police Media Spokesperson, Assistant Superintendent of Police (ASP) Fredrick Wootler, departed for France today (25) to participate in the First Global Conference for Public Communication organized by INTERPOL in Lyon.

title: Donald Trump cancels American delegation’s trip to Pakistan
byline: US President Donald Trump has called off planned meetings between his envoys and Iranian counterparts in Islamabad, Pakistan, where the parties were supposed to work toward a ceasefire deal to end the ongoing US-Iran war.
